title: Article
description: An encyclopedia entry that explains one or more concepts with context, history, examples, and references.

type.description: Must be 'article' for all encyclopedia entries.

id.description: Globally unique slug identifier using lowercase kebab-case.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this article was first created.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the most recent update.

authors.description: GitHub usernames or names of contributors.

concepts.description: IDs of Concept artifacts referenced in this article.

tags.description: Free-form labels for discovery and filtering.

discussion.description: ID of the primary Discussion artifact anchored to this article.

references.description: External citations (URLs, paper titles, book references).
